name: A day in the life of {X}
description: Diaristic walkthrough of a single day in the life of a person, role, animal, or system. First or second person. Concrete chronological pacing — wake, morning, midday, afternoon, evening, night. Pairs with Documentary, Educational, Comedy.
titleTemplate: A day in the life of {X}
openingDevice: Open with the moment of waking — when {X} begins their day. First-person voice (write 'I'). Set the time of day, the place, the body's first sensations, the first task or thought. Anchor the listener inside the head of {X} immediately; no narratorial distance.
bodyStructure: Chapter 1: Waking + morning routine. The first hour, the first decisions, the constraints of being {X}
Chapter 2: Morning's main work — the substantive thing {X} does first. What's involved, who else is around

Chapters 3-{lastButOne}: Midday and afternoon — meals, secondary tasks, encounters, the rhythms only {X} would notice. Move chronologically; one hour or one beat per chapter as the day's density demands
Chapter {last}: Evening + night — the wind-down, the moments of reflection, falling asleep. Close with the body's last sensations of the day
closingDevice: Close on the moment before sleep — the last thought, the room going quiet, the day folding away. Soft handoff to whatever tomorrow brings.
